correctness.rationale: Exact matrix entries give tr(M)=0 and A_d=-tr(M²)/2=(4-2d+d(ζ+ζ^-1))/d². All Galois conjugates lie in [4(1-d)/d²,4/d²], strictly within (-1,1) for odd d≥3; A_d≠0 because otherwise 2-4/d is a rational algebraic integer. Therefore its norm cannot be a nonzero integer, so A_d is nonintegral. A finite order matrix has cyclotomic, hence algebraic-integral coefficients; projective finite order implies true finite order after eighth powering because det M=1. The published invariant intertwiner transfers the conclusion to the harmonic and full walks, while the spectral projections yield generic nonreturn. The packaged verification code checks 131 independent finite identities but does not prove the infinite theorem.
